Monetary Policy Committee dates for 2026 and 2027

Dates for Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) announcements on Bank Rate and publication of MPC meeting minutes and the quarterly Monetary Policy Report.

2026 confirmed dates

Thursday 5 February February MPC Summary and minutes and February Monetary Policy Report
Thursday 19 March March MPC Summary and minutes
Thursday 30 April April MPC Summary and minutes and April Monetary Policy Report
Thursday 18 June June MPC Summary and minutes
Thursday 30 July July MPC Summary and minutes and July Monetary Policy Report
Thursday 17 September September MPC Summary and minutes
Thursday 5 November November MPC Summary and minutes and November Monetary Policy Report
Thursday 17 December December MPC Summary and minutes
